prompt: Build a multi-step checkout indicator at the top showing the current step: cart, shipping, then payment. Show a badge over a cart icon to signal the cart has two items.
response:
<bl-stepper type="dot" direction="horizontal">
  <bl-stepper-item variant="active" title="Cart"></bl-stepper-item>
  <bl-stepper-item title="Shipping"></bl-stepper-item>
  <bl-stepper-item title="Payment"></bl-stepper-item>
</bl-stepper>
<bl-badge size="small">
  <bl-icon slot="icon" name="cart"></bl-icon>
  2
</bl-badge>
